value: Consensus Game (MIT 2024) by Jacob, Shen, Farina, Andreas. Game-theoretic decoding: Generator proposes text, Discriminator evaluates truth. Iterate until equilibrium (agreement). Eliminates hallucinations by forcing internal consistency. Outperforms models 10x larger. Based on Diplomacy AI (Cicero). Paradigm shift in LLM decoding - not just better prompts, fundamentally different output generation.
